project.name: NextHire
project.tagline: AI-Powered Global Talent Intelligence & Recruitment SaaS Platform

stages.name: UI/UX & Design System Architecture
stages.summary: Full design tokens, dark/light theme, typography, responsive navigation, and atomic UI components.

stages.name: Frontend Portals & Multi-Role Interactive Flows
stages.summary: Completed Job Seeker dashboard, ATS Recruiter portal, Platform Admin command center, and public job board.

stages.name: Data Layer, ATS State Machine & RBAC Security
stages.summary: Prisma ORM schema with 14 models, multi-tenant UUID company isolation, strict state machine, and Edge middleware.

stages.name: Cloud Infrastructure & Third-Party Secrets Binding
stages.summary: Binding live production PostgreSQL (Neon/Supabase), Firebase production tokens, Stripe webhooks, and Cloudinary storage.

stages.name: Production Deployment & Go-Live
stages.summary: Building production bundle, deploying to Vercel/AWS Docker, mapping DNS for nexthire.cloud, and executing smoke tests.

technicalStack.frontend: Next.js 14 (App Router), React 18, TypeScript, TailwindCSS, Lucide Icons, Framer Motion
technicalStack.authentication: Dual-Engine: Native scrypt Password Hashing + Firebase Admin SDK ID Token Verification with HttpOnly Cookies
technicalStack.searchInfrastructure: Search Provider Abstraction Layer (NextHire DB, Google Custom Search, Bing, Brave, External Feeds) with 3s Resiliency & Dedup
technicalStack.authorization: Role-Based Access Control (JOB_SEEKER, RECRUITER, PLATFORM_ADMIN) with Edge Middleware & Multi-Tenant Company Isolation
technicalStack.seoAndStructuredData: Schema.org JobPosting JSON-LD, Dynamic XML Sitemap, Robots.txt

jobSeekerPortal.description: Hero query interface, live platform telemetry, category explorer, verified job cards, testimonial slider, FAQ.
Multi-criteria search (keyword, location, salary range, employment type, remote tags), real-time query aggregation.
Job specs, company profile overview, Google Jobs Schema.org JSON-LD, interactive application modal with resume upload.
Application status funnel, upcoming interview schedule cards, AI-recommended matches, saved jobs.
Multi-stage pipeline tracking (Submitted -> Review -> Interview -> Offer/Rejected) with SLA deadline monitors.
Constructive feedback breakdown, skill gap suggestions, recommended learning paths.
Live ATS resume scoring (0-100%), keyword density suggestions, formatting checks, AI improvement tips.
Comprehensive resume builder, skill tags, portfolio showcase, certificate upload with verification modal.
Direct conversation threads, attachment exchange, unread badges, timestamped messaging.
Notification settings, security password update, privacy profile visibility toggles.

recruiterSuite.description: Active job listings counter, time-to-hire analytics, applicant funnel, SLA alerts, quick posting CTA.
Candidate pipeline table/Kanban, match scoring, stage transition buttons, interview scheduling modal with Google Meet integration, structured rejection feedback composer.
Global candidate search, AI skill matching, candidate bookmarking, direct interview invitations.
Multi-step job poster with responsibilities, requirements, benefits, salary brackets, and SLA controls.
Company profile editor, verified badge status, culture media showcase, benefits list, office locations.
Subscription tiers (Starter, Growth, Enterprise), team seat manager, Stripe invoice history viewer.
Recruiter verification status, hiring performance metrics, public verification card.

platformAdministration.description: Platform-wide ARR/MRR metrics, system uptime telemetry, active users, company verification queue.
Role promotions/demotions (JOB_SEEKER, RECRUITER, PLATFORM_ADMIN), user suspensions, account inspection.
KYC/KYB business review queue, badge approval/revocation, company SLA policy overrides.
Stripe MRR tracking, customer churn telemetry, plan tier distribution breakdown.
Tamper-proof audit logs for status overrides, role modifications, and admin actions.

apiRouteCatalog.purpose: Authenticates user via database scrypt hash and sets secure HttpOnly session cookie
Creates new user in PostgreSQL and issues authenticated session
Verifies Firebase ID token server-side via Firebase Admin SDK and issues session
Revokes session token and clears auth cookie
Returns current authenticated user session data
Fetches filtered active jobs from PostgreSQL or search fallback
Creates a new job posting attached to the recruiter's company
Fetches jobs scoped to recruiter's multi-tenant company ID
Executes state-machine validated status update, triggers candidate notification, and logs audit trail
Executes parallel multi-provider search aggregation with 3s timeout resiliency and deduplication
Generates 15-minute presigned document download token for authorized resumes
Retrieves system-wide security and operational audit logs

enums: ApplicationStatus (SUBMITTED, UNDER_REVIEW, INTERVIEW_SCHEDULED, INTERVIEW_ROUND_1, INTERVIEW_ROUND_2, INTERVIEW_ROUND_3, FINAL_DECISION, OFFER_EXTENDED, REJECTED, APPLICATION_CLOSED)
EventType (STATUS_CHANGED, INTERVIEW_SCHEDULED, INTERVIEW_UPDATED, OFFER_CREATED, REJECTION_SUBMITTED, NOTE_ADDED, SLA_REMINDER_SENT, AUTO_CLOSED)
RejectionReason (MISSING_EXPERIENCE, MISSING_SKILLS, SALARY_MISMATCH, COMMUNICATION, TECHNICAL_PERFORMANCE, ROLE_CLOSED, CULTURE_FIT, POSITION_CANCELLED, OTHER)

preProductionAuditChecklist.action: Provision cloud PostgreSQL instance on Neon/Supabase and execute 'npx prisma db push'.
Add production domain (https://www.nexthire.cloud) to Firebase Console Authorized Domains.
Bind production Stripe live keys and point Stripe webhook endpoint to https://www.nexthire.cloud/api/billing/webhook.
Set up upload preset 'nexthire_resumes' with private delivery mode.
Verify DNS records (SPF, DKIM, DMARC) for notifications@nexthire.cloud.
Deploy build artifact to Vercel/Docker and configure DNS A/CNAME records.
